title: Aerial Analytics Execution Result
description: JSON Schema for output execution results returned by analytical plugins

execution_id.description: Matching execution identifier from input payload

status.description: Overall status of the plugin execution

execution_time_ms.description: Total processing time in milliseconds measured by plugin

metrics.description: Scalar metric values keyed by output metric identifiers

artifacts.description: Artifact files generated on disk keyed by output artifact identifiers

file_path.description: Absolute path to output artifact file on disk

bounds.description: Georeferenced bounding box [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] for raster overlay projection

error.description: Human-readable error diagnostic message if status is failure or warning
